name: Horsetooth Iron Distance
description:
First century / iron distance (by over 40 miles). Felt really good until I got hit by some atrocious headwind and crosswind on the way back that was pretty demoralizing and really took it out of me. I had fun experimenting with the aero bars though so we’ll just call it extra aero practice.

Oh and apparently today I hit one PCT worth of human powered miles in 2023.
